title: Notifications
intro: Choose what Voyager may send you. These settings follow your account on every device.

price_drops.label: Price drops
price_drops.hint: When a price you are watching falls.

trip_reminders.label: Trip reminders
trip_reminders.hint: A heads-up 30, 7 and 1 days before you go.

morning_brief.label: Morning brief
morning_brief.hint: Your plan for the day while you travel.

nearby.label: Near you
nearby.hint: Suggestions on this device when you are close to something interesting.

social.label: Social
social.hint: Likes, comments, new followers and saved ideas.

quiz.label: Quiz
quiz.hint: Head-to-head invites and results, and a daily quiz reminder.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.hint: No notifications during this window; they wait until it ends.
quiet.timezone: Quiet hours follow your account time zone: {{tz}}.
quiet.noTimezone: Set your time zone in Settings above so quiet hours know when to apply. Until then they are not applied.

cap.label: Daily limit
cap.hint: The most reminders and briefs we send you in one day. Price drops are not counted.

noDevices: Push notifications are not available on this device yet. Install the Voyager app and sign in to receive them; in-app notifications still work.

error.load: Could not load your notification settings.
error.save: Could not save that change. It was undone.
